subject.title: [Feature]: Clickable file links in chat with file viewer sidebar; workspace navigator previews any in-root file

question: Should `sessions.files.get` intentionally expand from transcript-touched files to any fs-safe in-workspace file for the Control UI file viewer?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the requested solution changes the Gateway file-content read boundary under `operator.read` and the issue is protected by the `maintainer` label.

options.title: Approve bounded workspace reads after PR fixes
options.body: Keep the linked PR direction, fix its reviewed blockers, and document or test that bounded in-root file contents are intentionally covered by the read scope.

options.title: Split UI links from read-scope expansion
options.body: Land chat file-link UI only for already authorized transcript-touched files, then decide workspace-wide content reads in a narrower follow-up.

options.title: Keep transcript-only previews
options.body: Preserve the current narrower read surface and leave arbitrary workspace file preview to a separate workspace API design.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded workspace reads after PR fixes
recommendation.body: Keep the linked PR direction, fix its reviewed blockers, and document or test that bounded in-root file contents are intentionally covered by the read scope.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the maintainer-labeled issue, authored the linked implementation PR, and are the clearest product owner for the UX and read-boundary choice.
